lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.complete_trexven_onboarding(p_business_name text, p_business_type text, p_country text, p_currency text, p_address text, p_phone text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/complete_trexven_onboarding`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
